text:
kai: FYI I created an urgent docs PR to patch the outage notes + short workaround for the streaming instability. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5199

rachel: thanks. we should include a clear "Known impact" bullet and link to the status incident. do we have that URL?

kai: yes: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03. Adding it to the header and the top of the incident doc.

omar: customers asked for minimal snippets they can paste. please add both Python and Go examples for the workaround (force sync mode).

kai: added a compact Python snippet in the PR. open to improvements.

rachel: can you add a Go example too? lot of infra folks use that.

kai: added this Go snippet as well: 

```go
// temporary: force synchronous responses to avoid streaming race condition
req := api.CreateResponseRequest{
    Model: "rw-large-v1",
    Input: "Summarize incident impact",
    ResponseMode: api.ResponseModeSync,
}
resp, err := client.Responses.Create(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.OutputText)
```

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/5199 1 CI checks passed, 1 docs lint warning (broken anchor in TOC).

omar: can someone fix the TOC anchor? small follow-up commit and we can merge in the emergency window.

kai: fixed anchor and tightened wording under "Workarounds". added a sentence noting potentially higher latency and token costs when using sync mode.

rachel: security: quick question on the workaround text mentioning KMS key rotation. make sure we don't imply customer keys were exposed. pinging @security for wording sign-off.

security: quick review done, suggest replacing "KMS affected" with "KMS operations delayed" to avoid alarmism. Also confirm we don't mention internal debug logs.

kai: updated wording per security. thanks.

docs-ci-bot: New preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/5199-2 1 all checks green.

omar: who can approve? need to merge before the 10:30 PT deploy window.

rachel: I can approve copy. @kai can you get product to ack the messaging?

kai: pinged product on PR, they ack'd the customer-facing language earlier.

rachel: approved from docs side. small nit: move the SDK snippets into a collapsible "Temporary workaround" block so they don't clutter the main page.

kai: done. collapsed block added.

security: approved. :white_check_mark:

rachel: approving now. :+1:

kai: merging emergency PR now.

deploy-bot: Docs canary publish queued for 10:15 PT 1 will publish on merge.

kai: added a cross-link to the SDK examples index and to the migration guide for teams planning to pin to non-streaming flows.

omar: thanks. I'll open a follow-up non-urgent PR to add expanded examples and a troubleshooting checklist.

kai: live docs link post-merge: https://docs.redwood.ai/platform/known-issues#incident-2026-03. Leaving this thread open for any late corrections.

rachel: closing loop for this hotfix. let's track the longer examples in the follow-up PR.

omar: noted. please remind support to reference the status page and the workaround when responding to customers.

kai: done, support ticket template updated.

rachel: thanks everyone 1 great quick turnaround.
